compiled_state.description:
## Problem (parity siblings of the tickets-branch invariant violation)
Two more tickets-branch writers bypass the shared store seams and the two-part invariant
(under the unified write lock + auto-commit/publish), same class as projects_store
(ticket fea4-f98c-f1a2-4168):
1. reconcile_helpers._commit_binding_store_snapshot (reconcile_helpers.py:169) commits
   .bridge_state binding/rotation/link state via raw git_adapter.add + commit. git_adapter
   imports only rebar._store.gitutil.run_git — it does NOT acquire rebar._store.lock.write_lock,
   so it races the ticket-CLI _push_tickets_branch() and concurrent GHA commit-back (the
   exact race the write lock exists to prevent). Its own docstring documents the
   "un-committed local copy silently overwritten by a concurrent run" bug it half-fixes
   WITHOUT taking the lock.
2. alert_store._atomic_write (alert_store.py:84) hand-rolls tempfile+os.replace instead of
   the shared rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write seam.

## Use the EXISTING seams (NO new facade, NO redesign) — same as ticket fea4
- rebar._store.push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch(tracker, *, message=...) — commits all
  pending tracker changes under the unified write lock (+ rebase guard) then pushes.
- rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write — the shared crash-atomic write.

## Approach
1. _commit_binding_store_snapshot: replace the lock-bypassing raw git_adapter add/commit
   with a call to the EXISTING push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch (which stages+commits
   pending tracker changes under write_lock and pushes). Preserve its fail-open posture (a
   commit/push failure must still NOT abort the pass — keep the try/except returning False
   and logging). The existing seam already scopes to pending changes; confirm the binding
   state files are what gets committed and that its per-file idempotency (bug 1e08) and no-op
   -when-clean behavior are preserved (commit_and_push is a no-op when the tree is clean).
2. alert_store._atomic_write -> fsutil.atomic_write. FIRST determine whether the
   .bridge_state/bridge_alerts files are committed to the tickets branch (GHA commit-back)
   or local-only scratch: if committed, they are already published by the same commit-back /
   commit_and_push path (no extra lock work needed here — just the atomic_write swap); if
   local scratch, fsutil.atomic_write alone suffices. Document the finding.

## Constraints — BEHAVIOR-PRESERVING
Verify NO functional change: same files committed, same idempotent no-op when nothing
changed, same graceful-degradation on git error (fail-open), same serialized bytes for
alert files. Pin these with tests before/after. Reuse existing seams ONLY — add no new
helper.

## Acceptance criteria
1. _commit_binding_store_snapshot serializes through the unified write lock (via
   commit_and_push_tickets_branch); behavior otherwise identical (idempotency, fail-open).
2. alert_store uses fsutil.atomic_write; residency (committed vs scratch) determined +
   documented; correct existing seam applied.
3. No functional/behavioral change beyond lock+seam adoption (pinned by tests).

## Sequencing
Depends on fea4 landing first ONLY to avoid two concurrent edits to the reconciler commit
path and to inherit the same seam choice. Edits reconcile_helpers.py + alert_store.py
(+ tests) — disjoint from A/C/D. Rebase onto fea4 before starting.
